_meta.source: Pokémon Reborn v19.5 game data (Map###.rxdata event pages)

rules.self: command 123 [letter, 0] (self switch ON) after the item/trainer call on the same page, and a later page conditioned on that self switch
rules.switch: command 121 [id, id, 0] (game switch ON) after the call, and a later page conditioned on that game switch
rules.script: pbSetSelfSwitch(@event_id|<ev>,"X",true) / $game_self_switches[[..,..,"X"]]=true in a script after the call counts as command 123
rules.fallback: no explicit ON after the call: the only later page conditioned on a self switch (marked 'inferred' in stats)
rules.variable: command 122 [id, id, set|add, constant, n] after the call, and a later page conditioned on that variable reaching a value the command produces (story progress variables only grow); done when the variable is >= min
rules.value: "A".. "D" = self switch letter; {"switch": n} = game switch id is ON; {"var": id, "min": n} = game variable id >= n
